articles.title: Moms and Babies Not Being Heard: UK Promises Big Changes
articles.summary: A new report says many moms and babies are being failed in UK hospitals. The government promises 1,000 new midwife jobs and better emergency care. Some families say the plan doesn't go far enough.

articles.title: Supreme Court Says: If You're Born in the USA, You're a Citizen!
articles.summary: The U.S. Supreme Court ruled that all babies born in America are citizens, even if their parents are not. This was a big loss for President Trump, who wanted to change the 150-year-old rule.

articles.title: Scorching Heat Wave to Bake Midwest and East Coast for July 4th
articles.summary: A massive heat wave will hit over 100 million people this week, with temperatures up to 105°F. Experts say stay inside, drink water, and take breaks. The extreme heat is linked to climate change.
